messages.content:
You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value (as written, then in normal form in brackets), sometimes a condition,
and the place it comes from. Some facts carry a note computed from the dates: trust the notes.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the facts, one by one, before you answer.
  A repeal, a limit or an application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a
  date is still fully in force, with everything it permits, on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does
  not yet bind on earlier days.
- If a note says that a date quoted in a condition was corrected, reason with the corrected date.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the
  facts, one item per fact. Facts filed under the same article, annex part or numbered point belong together.
  When the answer is a group named by an article or an annex part and the facts list the members of that group,
  give the members, not the name of the group.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "for how long" alone is "duration";
  "can / may / is / does" is "boolean"; "which / what (several things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition,
  or who does something and within what time is "text", and the text names every element asked for.
- Return JSON only, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "the facts and dates compared, step by step, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: What must accompany machinery when it is placed on the market?

Facts:
[0] machinery or related product — mustAccompany — accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity (EU declaration of conformity) [condition: Before making machinery or a related product available on the market] [REG, Art. 15(2)]
[1] manufacturer of partly completed machinery or authorised representative — hasObligation — shall, before placing it on the market, ensure that (shall, before placing it on the market, ensure that) [condition: before placing it on the market] [DIR, Art. 13(1)]
[2] partly completed machinery — mustAccompany — accompanied by the required documents (accompanied by the required documents) [condition: Before placing partly completed machinery on the market] [REG, Art. 14(2)]
[3] machinery — mustAccompany — accompanied by instructions (instructions) [condition: in the official Community language or languages of the Member State in which it is placed on the market and/or put into service] [DIR, Annex I, 1.7.4]
[4] manufacturer or authorised representative — hasObligation — ensure that the technical file referred to in Annex VII, part A is available (ensure that the technical file referred to in annex vii, part a is available) [condition: Before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service] [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[5] machinery or related product — mustAccompany — accompanied by the instructions for use (instructions for use and the information referred to in Article 10(7)) [condition: in a language which can be easily understood by users, as determined by the Member State in which the machinery or related product is to be made available on the market] [REG, Art. 15(2)]
[6] machinery or related product — mustAccompany — a document accompanying the machinery (a document accompanying the machinery) [condition: where the size or nature of the machinery or related product does not allow this] [REG, Art. 10(5)]
[7] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — shall ensure that the procedure referred to in Article 13 has been completed (shall ensure that the procedure referred to in article 13 has been completed) [condition: before placing partly completed machinery on the market] [DIR, Art. 5(2)]
[8] manufacturer or authorised representative — hasObligation — ensure that it satisfies the relevant essential health and safety requirements (ensure that it satisfies the relevant essential health and safety requirements) [condition: Before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service] [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[9] machinery — mustAccompany — EC declaration of conformity (ec declaration of conformity) [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[10] manufacturer of the machinery — hasObligation — ensuring that the said machinery meets the corresponding state of the art (ensuring that the said machinery meets the corresponding state of the art) [DIR, Annex IX]
[11] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed (shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed) [condition: When placing partly completed machinery on the market] [REG, Art. 11(1)]
[12] machinery or related product — mustAccompany — EU declaration of conformity set out in Annex V, Part A (EU declaration of conformity set out in Annex V, Part A) [condition: or alternatively, internet address or machine-readable code where that EU declaration of conformity can be accessed in the instructions for use] [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[13] machinery or related product — mustAccompany — is accompanied by the required documents (is accompanied by the required documents) [REG, Art. 13(2)]
[14] manufacturer, digital instructions — hasObligation — mark on the machinery or related product (mark on the machinery or related product) [condition: where that is not possible, on its packaging or in an accompanying document] [REG, Art. 10(7)]
[15] importer of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall ensure that the manufacturer has drawn up (shall ensure that the manufacturer has drawn up) [condition: Before placing partly completed machinery on the market] [REG, Art. 14(2)]
[16] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall draw up the technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part B (shall draw up the technical documentation set out in annex iv, part b) [condition: Before placing partly completed machinery on the market] [REG, Art. 11(2)]
[17] importers of machinery and related products — hasObligation — shall place only compliant machinery (shall place only compliant machinery) [REG, Art. 13(1)]
[18] manufacturers — hasObligation — shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed (shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed) [condition: When placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service] [REG, Art. 10(1)]
[19] importer of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall inform the manufacturer and the market surveillance authorities (shall inform the manufacturer and the market surveillance authorities) [condition: where the partly completed machinery presents a risk as regards the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [REG, Art. 14(2)]

[21] manufacturer or authorised representative — hasObligation — must ensure (must ensure) [condition: When lifting machinery or lifting accessories are placed on the market or are first put into service] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.3]

[26] declaration of incorporation of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — must contain the following particulars (must contain the following particulars) [DIR, Annex II, 1]
[27] distributor of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall inform the manufacturer or the importer as well as the market surveillance authorities (shall inform the manufacturer or the importer as well as the market surveillance authorities) [condition: where the partly completed machinery presents a risk as regards relevant essential health and safety requirements] [REG, Art. 16(3)]
[28] manufacturer — hasObligation — shall cease the placing on the market of the machinery concerned (cease the placing on the market of the machinery concerned) [condition: In the event that the validity of the EC-type examination certificate is not renewed] [DIR, Annex IX]
[29] machinery or related product — mustAccompany — the information referred to in Article 10(7) (the information referred to in article 10(7)) [REG, Art. 13(4)]
[30] machinery not assembled on manufacturer's premises — mustAccompany — the necessary instructions for performing the measures (instructions for performing measures referred to in section 4.1.3) [condition: for machinery which is not assembled on the premises of the manufacturer in the form in which it is to be used] [DIR, Annex I, 4.4.2]

[32] lifting machinery or related products — mustAccompany — instructions for use (instructions for use) [REG, Annex III, 4.4.2]
[33] importers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall place only compliant partly completed machinery (shall place only compliant partly completed machinery) [REG, Art. 14(1)]
[34] machinery or related products — mustAccompany — the instructions for use and the information set out in Annex III (the instructions for use and the information set out in annex iii) [REG, Art. 10(7)]
[35] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — Manufacturers shall indicate their name (manufacturers shall indicate their name) [condition: where that is not possible, on its packaging or in a document accompanying the partly completed machinery] [REG, Art. 11(6)]
[36] lifting machinery or related products — mustAccompany — necessary instructions for performing the measures (necessary instructions for performing the measures) [condition: for lifting machinery or related products, which are not assembled on the premises of the manufacturer in the form in which they are to be used] [REG, Annex III, 4.4.2]
[37] any natural or legal person who places on the market or puts into service machinery — becomesManufacturer — shall be considered a manufacturer (shall be considered a manufacturer) [condition: In the absence of a manufacturer as defined above] [DIR, Art. 2]
[38] manufacturer — hasObligation — mark on the partly completed machinery (mark on the partly completed machinery) [condition: where that is not possible, on its packaging or in an accompanying document] [REG, Art. 11(7)]
[39] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — a test report (a test report) [condition: where appropriate] [REG, Annex III, 4.4.2]
[40] partly completed machinery — mustAccompany — assembly instructions (assembly instructions) [condition: in a language which can be easily understood by the person who incorporates the partly completed machinery as determined by the Member State in which the partly completed machinery is to be made available on the market] [REG, Art. 16(2)]
[41] manufacturer — hasObligation — ensure that the machinery or related products are accompanied by (ensure that the machinery or related products are accompanied by) [REG, Art. 10(7)]

[44] manufacturers — hasObligation — carry out sample testing (carry out sample testing of machinery or related products made available on the market) [condition: When deemed appropriate with regard to the risks presented by machinery or related products] [REG, Art. 10(4)]
[45] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall keep the technical documentation (shall keep the technical documentation and the EU declaration of incorporation at the disposal of the market surveillance authorities) [REG, Art. 11(3)]
[46] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — must be accompanied by instructions (instructions) [DIR, Annex I, 4.4.2]
[47] manufacturers — hasObligation — shall indicate their name (shall indicate their name) [condition: where that is not possible, on its packaging or in a document accompanying the machinery or related product] [REG, Art. 10(6)]
[48] partly completed machinery — mustAccompany — assembly instructions and the declaration of incorporation (assembly instructions and the declaration of incorporation) [condition: until it is incorporated into the final machinery] [DIR, Art. 13(2)]
[49] manufacturers — hasObligation — affix the CE marking in accordance with Article 24 (affix the ce marking in accordance with article 24) [condition: Where compliance of machinery or a related product with the essential health and safety requirements laid down in Annex III has been demonstrated by that conformity assessment procedure] [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[50] products placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC — placingAllowedUntil — 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) [condition: placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC before 20 January 2027] [CORR, Corrigendum, point 6]
[51] portable cartridge-operated fixing and other impact machinery — placingAllowedUntil — Until 29 June 2011 (2011-06-29) [condition: which are in conformity with the national provisions in force upon adoption of this Directive] [DIR, Art. 27]
[52] Chapter VI of this Regulation (mutatis mutandis to such products) — appliesFrom — 19 July 2023 (2023-07-19) [condition: mutatis mutandis to such products instead of Article 11 of that Directive, including products for which a procedure has already been initiated under Article 11 of Directive 2006/42/EC] [CORR, Corrigendum, point 7]

[62] manufacturer of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — assembly instructions described in Annex VI are prepared (assembly instructions described in annex vi are prepared) [DIR, Art. 13(1)]

response.text: {"reasoning": "Today is 2026-11-14. The Directive 2006/42/EC is repealed only from 2027-01-20 (fact 60), so it still governs placing machinery on the market today. The Regulation applies from 2027-01-20 (fact 54), so its accompanying-document rules do not yet bind. The Directive facts that say what must accompany machinery are: the instructions (fact 3, Annex I 1.7.4), the EC declaration of conformity (fact 9, Art. 5(1)), and the original instructions or a translation of them (fact 64, Annex I 1.7.4). Facts 46 and 30 are limited to lifting machinery or machinery not assembled on the manufacturer's premises, so they are not general answers.", "kind": "set", "value": ["instructions (Annex I, 1.7.4)", "EC declaration of conformity (Art. 5(1))", "original instructions or a translation of the original instructions (Annex I, 1.7.4)"], "text": "Under Directive 2006/42/EC, which still applies on 2026-11-14, machinery placed on the market must be accompanied by its instructions (Annex I, point 1.7.4), which must be the original instructions or a translation of them, and by the EC declaration of conformity (Article 5(1)). The Regulation's parallel rules apply only from 2027-01-20.", "used": [3, 9, 64, 60, 54]}
